mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates by > 1pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and compress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 1% y/y, it signals a weakening labor market that will drag on consumer spending and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS y/y growth < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 2% y/y, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost economic activity and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where HOUST y/y growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth decelerates by more than 1% y/y, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector that will drag on economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO y/y growth < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending growth (RSAFS) accelerates by more than 2% y/y, it signals a strengthening consumer sector that will boost economic activity and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in the early-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances where RSAFS y/y growth > 2% in early-cycle regimes.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3%, it signals rising inflationary pressures that will prompt the Fed to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if the economy is already in a late-cycle slowdown regime.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3% in late-cycle slowdown regimes.
